availability_verbatim: Any legal resident of the US under 22 yrs old; must be at least 10 to open checking

requirements.verbatim: Day 30: Open both accounts with minimums ($10 checking, $5 savings, $100 CD)
Day 60: Keep both accounts open and enroll in eStatements
Day 90: Keep both accounts open and complete one mobile deposit

fee_waiver: No monthly fees on these accounts
notes: Age-gated: any US resident under 22 (min age 10 to open checking). Application may currently be dead ('This application is currently unavailable' per top of post) - flagged in notes since this affects offer viability but does not change the terms. Bonus is a 3-stage milestone structure ($50 at day 30/60/90) rather than a true deposit/balance tier, so tiers[] modeled loosely with threshold_kind 'other' and null thresholds since there is no dollar threshold gating each stage - only time and account-open-status. Requirement minimums ($10 checking/$5 savings/$100 CD) captured under a single 'deposit' requirement for the day-30 stage.
